findings.issue: Concurrent registry initialization could fail durable callback registration with SQLite BUSY.
findings.disposition: Fixed by reserving immediate SQLite write transactions before initialization; native concurrent callback and publication regressions pass.

findings.issue: State allocation could create an owned hooks-file path as a directory before installer validation.
findings.disposition: Fixed placement preflight before allocation; original installer rollback oracle preserved and passes.

findings.issue: Configuration updates emitted four-space YAML indentation and invalidated the strict shared version pin.
findings.disposition: Fixed by the storage coder with two-space YAML encoding and a full config/entrypoint roundtrip oracle; discovered by relocation coder during migration testing.

findings.issue: Missing configuration produced a state-field error instead of the established initialization guidance.
findings.disposition: Fixed absent-file classification without relaxing required-field validation for existing files.

findings.issue: Adding Git to an already captured directory was rejected as changed ownership.
findings.disposition: Fixed monotonic Git ownership enrichment only for the unchanged directory; read-only access does not persist enrichment and replacements remain rejected.

findings.issue: Adding the required state setting could abandon pending legacy state at its implicit local location.
findings.disposition: Storage coder discovered and reproduced the administrative upgrade case; relocation coder added preservation guard and the original native CLI regression now passes.

findings.issue: Shared registry file URIs treated a Windows drive as a URI authority and blocked capture installation.
findings.disposition: Fixed typed SQLite file URIs; actual native Windows capture installation passed after the correction (1test36.962s).

findings.issue: Legacy installation discovery anchors prevented relocation from completing after source fencing.
findings.disposition: Fixed explicit legacy-anchor authorization using validated old state, repository and source; disabled installation, interrupted manifest2/anchor1 resume and foreign-anchor preservation races pass.

findings.issue: Repo-local capture installation ignored only coordination files and left the shared database and SQLite sidecars visible to Git.
findings.disposition: Fixed: ignore the entire logical registry including peer coordination and SQLite sidecars; real Git-ignore oracle passes.

findings.issue: Windows home state on another volume was rejected as an invalid placement instead of disjoint external state.
findings.disposition: Fixed: classify Windows different-volume paths as disjoint while preserving same-volume containment and unsafe-path errors; native Windows component passes.

findings.issue: Interrupted configuration replacement could remove the active path and leave a permanent update lock.
findings.disposition: Fixed: atomic old/new replacement with crash-released OS coordination and CAS; actual process-death and retry controls pass.

findings.issue: A relocation destination accepted callbacks before its pending fence was installed.
findings.disposition: Fixed: reserve ownership and pending fences atomically before retiring source; ordinary and already-open writes remain blocked until activation.

findings.issue: An interrupted hooks-before-manifest write stranded migration retries.
findings.disposition: Fixed: durable typed owned before/after-prefix installation journal recovers exact partial writes while preserving foreign edits.

findings.issue: Relocation bypassed changed physical ownership of an existing destination.
findings.disposition: Fixed: validate existing destination identity before source retirement and throughout allocation, import and activation.

findings.issue: Retained foreign history lost supported event and evidence fields during publication compaction.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preserve authorized typed historical sessions after own-session compaction; strict fidelity and private-body rejection controls pass.

findings.issue: Administrative state-move checks used an unnormalized project name and missed existing populated state.
findings.disposition: Fixed: administrative decoding uses the operational raw DTO conversion; native spaced, aliased, numeric and case controls pass.

findings.issue: Concurrent configuration updates could strand a successfully registered callback at the old state path.
findings.disposition: Fixed: shared effective-configuration admission covers resolution and first allocation within the existing deadline; updater rechecks movement under the same leases.

findings.issue: Supported committed schema4 sessions without cost evidence failed publication under schema5.
findings.disposition: Fixed: apply the existing narrow legacy cost mapping before history publication, preserving other facts and explicit evidence; original oracle and repeated v4 controls pass.

findings.issue: Registry and installation manifest compatibility shared one version constant.
findings.disposition: Fixed: separate registry and installation manifest constants and responsibility-specific production consumers; current numeric protocols unchanged.

findings.issue: Migration tests did not detect omission of six populated continuation and recovery tables.
findings.disposition: Closed verification gap: exact populated six-table, accepted-snapshot and real publication-journal oracles pass; each omission mutant now fails.

findings.issue: Inherited Git repository overrides could authorize auxiliary-only committed facts from a foreign repository.
findings.disposition: Fixed: environment-isolated bounded history Git commands and physical repository proof for all committed authority, including auxiliary-only facts.

findings.issue: A namespace symlink let relocation retire the source and activate a destination that normal capture could not reopen.
findings.disposition: Fixed: completed namespaces must be physically contained and idempotent before allocation or source retirement; valid base/coordination aliases remain supported.

findings.issue: A feedback test raced a detached worker and mistook a legitimate competing-worker success for failure.
findings.disposition: Fixed test synchronization with a new durable generation, acknowledgement and actual worker lease; failure, recovery and privacy assertions retained.

findings.issue: The canonical frontend build invoked Unix copy commands under Windows cmd and failed before native verification.
findings.disposition: Fixed with module-relative Node filesystem synchronization; real Windows original/fixed canonical builds and strict regression verify exact asset replacement.

findings.issue: Windows installation required an unavailable Get-FileHash cmdlet and failed before artifact activation.
findings.disposition: Fixed with streaming .NET SHA-256; native unavailable-cmdlet, valid/invalid checksum, retention and complete distribution/transport checks pass.

findings.issue: The initial cryptography replacement resolved relative files against process cwd instead of PowerShell location.
findings.disposition: Corrected before publication using literal PowerShell provider resolution; native Set-Location and independent digest regressions pass.

findings.issue: The Windows watchdog test assumed the PowerShell body wrote PID records before its bounded startup deadline.
findings.disposition: Fixed test-only startup and owned-tree oracles; controlled delay reproduces the old assumption, native repeats and negative controls pass. Hosted timing cause remains unproven.

findings.issue: Windows Python text-mode fixture input translated LF to CRLF before a byte-preservation assertion.
findings.disposition: Fixed test transport with explicit UTF-8 bytes and exact newline/Unicode/empty payload oracles; native Python and WSL suites pass, normalizing wrapper mutation rejected.

findings.issue: Native Windows Python text-mode payload-file creation changed LF before the plugin transport byte oracle.
findings.disposition: Fixed fixture file creation with explicit UTF-8 bytes; original native failure reproduced and all six native plugin cases pass with exact assertions unchanged.
